recommended_disposition: Publish either in a small dedicated Lean-sidecar DOI or as a support artifact linked from the relevant author records and workflow record. Do not present as certification of the editions.
summary: Clean extraction of small project-relevant Lean/Mathlib sidecars found in the Downloads helix_extract tree. The packet keeps only Noether, Steinitz, Weber, and Jordan/AffineGroup classical-audit Lean files plus minimal Lean project metadata and build logs. Unrelated helix/phaser paper material, Python demos, SplitZero, and non-manuscript side research were deliberately excluded.
global_caveat: Lean sidecars are formalization-aided sanity anchors for selected claims with clean Mathlib counterparts or simple identities. They are not source certification, not critical editions, not proof that the historical transcription is complete, and not a replacement for page-level source audit.

artifacts.classification: Small Lean sidecar/support packet with NoetherIdealtheorie.lean, Steinitz.lean, Weber.lean, AffineGroup.lean, build logs, lean-toolchain, lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, checksums, and a README.

included_sidecars.scope: Noether, Idealtheorie in Ringbereichen: finite ideal basis / Noetherian ring anchor and primary ideal condition anchor.
Steinitz, Algebraische Theorie der Koerper: perfect field / Frobenius surjectivity anchor.
Weber, Lehrbuch der Algebra: abstract Weber cubic identity sidecar.
Jordan, Traite des substitutions: affine line group cardinality sidecar.
